result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major content/localization problem and one minor layout issue.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed as a raw localization key instead of the translated user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization string for 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly loaded and mapped to the correct translation in the active language.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Picco' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scrollable area padding or card sizing so that the last card is not visually clipped.
